title: The Scripture is the Final Authority over our Practice and Doctrine
paragraphs: The Scripture is the Final Authority over our Practice and Doctrine
It sounds spiritual… until it confronts you.
“The Scripture is the final authority over our practice and doctrine.”
But here’s what most people don’t realize…

That statement doesn’t sit quietly on a shelf.
It walks into your life, opens every hidden room, and starts turning over tables.
Read that again.

Because if Scripture is truly final…
then your opinions aren’t.
Your traditions aren’t.
Even your feelings aren’t.
And that’s where the tension begins.
Picture it.

A dimly lit room.
Dust floating in the air.
An open Bible on the table—pages worn, not decorative.

Not a prop.
A verdict.
And somewhere in that room… you.

Not the version of you people see.
The real one.

The one with secret compromises.
The quiet justifications.
The “I know what it says, but…” moments.
Because Scripture doesn’t just inform.
It confronts.
It exposes.
It divides truth from illusion.
And that’s the breaking point most avoid.

We love verses that comfort us.
We resist the ones that correct us.

We quote what inspires…
and quietly ignore what demands surrender.
But here’s the truth you can’t outrun:

If Scripture is not your final authority…
then something else is.

And whatever replaces it—
culture, emotion, success, even religion—
will never lead you to life.
This is where everything shifts.
Because Scripture doesn’t just reveal what’s wrong.
It reveals why.
Sin.

Not mistakes.
Not flaws.
Sin.
Rebellion against a holy God.
And no amount of good works, discipline, or “trying harder” fixes that.

This is where most teachings stop…
but not here.
Because the story doesn’t end in exposure.
It moves to rescue.
Jesus Christ.

Not a concept.
Not a motivational figure.
The Son of God.

Perfect. Sinless.
Crucified for your sin.

Not symbolically.
Substitutionally.
He took the judgment Scripture demands.
And then—He rose.

Defeating sin.
Defeating death.
Offering grace you could never earn.
Salvation is not achieved.
It is received.

By grace.
Through faith.
In Him alone.
But here’s what most people still don’t realize…

If Scripture is your final authority,
then Jesus is not optional.

You don’t get His promises without His Lordship.
You don’t get grace without repentance.

You don’t rewrite the Gospel to fit your life—
He rewrites your life through the Gospel.
Originally written by Gospel Warrior.

And if this is hitting deeper than expected…
that’s not by accident.
So what now?
Not agreement.
Response.

Turn from sin.
Trust in Christ.
Submit to His Word—not partially, but fully.
Because partial obedience is still rebellion.
And Scripture doesn’t negotiate.
It transforms.
But don’t stop here.

If you’re serious about not just hearing truth—but living it—
this is where you go next:
Now let me ask you:
What in your life is still arguing with Scripture?
And follow the source… because what you’ve just read is only the beginning.
Because when Scripture becomes final…
Everything else falls into place.
Or falls apart.
And only one of those leads to life.
